cost_status: Round analyst-selected display assumptions, not procurement estimates or calibrated generator costs
frequency_status: Sensitivity coordinates; not estimated hurricane return periods
valuation_status: Inherited load-level sector/duration model; 0.5x and 1.5x are analyst sensitivities, not confidence limits
boundary: Incremental economic value of export from the same connected DC portfolio; community avoided damage less export-enablement resources
not_included: DC construction and ordinary operation, common to both cases
ordinary adequacy burden and upstream capacity costs, common to both export cases
tax receipts, tax incentives, jobs, or compensation transfers
incremental emissions damages; require updated generator/emission assumptions
equipment replacements, salvage, or cost escalation
event_repeat_assumption: Stationary representative-event mean with full readiness restored between events; no overlapping events or inter-event resource carryover
